image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a dark, textured substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping pale green/whitish calcareous plates running down the center of its back. These plates are surrounded by a brownish, granular girdle (mantle). The image focuses on the dorsal surface; the ventral foot is not visible.
